pairs.why: The two flashlights are almost pixel-identical in shape, gloss, colour and light, so neither one is meaningfully closer to the real cards.
This is the same near-identical flashlight pair, with no visible difference in rendering or build to choose between.
B's clear pale-blue lens with soft reflections matches the glass in the real map card's magnifier, while A's green-tinted lens with a hard white hotspot looks more like glossy stylised plastic.
A has the clear pale-blue glass that matches the real magnifier, while B's green lens with a hard specular dot reads as off-style.

A is built like a real wallet, with stitched edges and a properly formed badge, like the lessons' preferred well-built saddles; B's featureless blob badge and clay-smooth leather look too simplified, though A's dark wood is moodier than the real cards' warm settings.
B has the stitched leather and the properly built shield badge, while A's plain gold blob and ultra-smooth clay finish read as less like a real object.
The bags are essentially identical, but B's warm, bright orange wood matches the real book and map cards, while A's dark brown wood is gloomier than the game's lighting.
Same bag on both sides; A's bright warm orange wood matches the real cards, while B's dark wood looks too moody.
